items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel
items.claim: The LORD heard the murmurings of the children of Israel.
items.object: the murmurings of the children of Israel

items.quote: At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread
items.claim: The children of Israel will eat flesh at evening and be filled with bread in the morning.

items.quote: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God
items.claim: The children of Israel will know that the LORD is their God.
items.object: that I am the LORD your God
